objective: Implement Phase C: Real Document Source Ingestion (PDF, TXT, Markdown) with Server-Side Extraction & Persistent Source Metadata
acceptance_criteria: Real server-side text extraction for PDF (page-by-page preservation via unpdf, image-only detection), Plain Text (.txt with line numbers), and Markdown (.md with headings/code blocks)
Drag-and-drop and browse file upload UI in SourceManagerView with file size and progress telemetry (10MB limit, max 5 files per batch)
Every uploaded file creates a persistent source record with SHA-256 hash, MIME type, file size, page/line metadata, extracted text, and safe isolated storage
Backend API endpoints: POST /api/sources/upload (multipart/form-data), GET /api/sources/[id], DELETE /api/sources/[id]
UI integration: Uploaded sources appear in sources list, distinguished from synthetic demo sources, with View Extracted Content modal and Remove Source action
Zero fake AI extraction: Strictly store genuine extracted document content for Phase D without hallucinating artificial decisions or tasks
Zero login/signup invariant and multi-visitor anonymous workspace isolation strictly maintained
Automated test suite covers TXT, Markdown, PDF extraction, multi-file uploads, size limits, unsupported extensions, malformed PDFs, empty files, and deletion
Production build and typecheck pass with zero errors
non_goals: Do not implement real LLM integration or AI entity extraction in this phase (Phase D)
Do not alter Google Stitch design tokens or warm sage visual styling
Do not break Phase A handover integrity rules or Phase B persistence architecture

verification.result: 30/30 unit and integration tests passed (Phase A: 8/8, Phase B: 10/10, Phase C: 12/12 covering TXT, Markdown, PDF page extraction, scanned PDF detection, malformed handling, 10MB limits, workspace isolation, deletion). Production build succeeded with exit code 0 (12 dynamic API routes and 6 static pages generated).
